{{Top|leg}}
'''Hem trees''' were a species of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. After the defeat of the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] and his fellow [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] planted hem trees in the burnt-out ruins of the [[Endor shield generator bunker|Imperial shield generator bunker]].<ref name="GG5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hem trees were only mentioned in the first edition of ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]'',<ref name="GG5" /> but the mention was omitted in the the [[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|second edition]].<ref name="GG5 second">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'' Second Edition]]</ref>
